trello.name: Create Stripe Products and Prices for subscription tiers
trello.desc: Set up three subscription products in Stripe Dashboard and API: Basic $29/month, Pro $49/month, Enterprise $99/month. Define features for each tier as discussed: Basic = basic access to AI model selection tool + limited feature set; Pro = additional features + priority support; Enterprise = all features + custom support + integration options. Ensure products are recurring monthly, prices are correct, and metadata maps to app feature flags. Acceptance criteria: products visible in Stripe, prices match spec, test customers can be created for each tier.

trello.name: Design and implement Pricing Page UI
trello.desc: Update frontend pricing page to display Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with clear feature comparison table. Design must be clean and straightforward with prominent checkout buttons per tier. Add tooltip or help icon explaining plan changes later. Ensure design matches app branding. Acceptance criteria: pricing page renders three tiers with correct prices and features, comparison is readable, checkout buttons are prominent, tooltip is present and accurate.

trello.name: Implement Stripe Elements Checkout Flow
trello.desc: Build checkout form using Stripe Elements on frontend. Form should match app design, collect payment details securely, and handle errors gracefully for invalid card details, insufficient funds, etc. Integrate checkout initiation with backend to create Stripe Checkout Session or Payment Intent for selected tier. Acceptance criteria: checkout form renders correctly, Stripe Elements styled to app, errors displayed clearly to user, successful checkout returns user to success page.

trello.name: Build User Dashboard Subscription Management UI
trello.desc: Create user dashboard section showing current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, access to invoices and payment history, and ability to update payment methods. Dashboard must reflect subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes like successful upgrades or payment failures. Acceptance criteria: dashboard displays current plan and billing, upgrade/downgrade/cancel actions work, invoices list loads, payment method update works, status updates in real-time.

trello.name: Implement Backend Stripe Subscription API Integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe API on backend to create and manage subscriptions, process payments, and handle subscription lifecycle. Implement endpoints for creating subscription on plan selection, retrieving subscription status, updating payment method, and handling upgrades/downgrades/cancellations. Store subscription ID and status in app database linked to user. Acceptance criteria: backend can create subscription, retrieve status, update/cancel subscription via API, data persisted correctly.

trello.name: Configure Webhook Endpoints and Handlers
trello.desc: Set up webhook listeners in backend for Stripe events: invoice.payment_succeeded to confirm payments and activate/continue subscription; invoice.payment_failed to notify users and prompt payment method update with email notification; customer.subscription.deleted to update access rights and handle cancellation. Ensure handlers are idempotent and update app database accordingly. Acceptance criteria: webhooks receive events in Stripe CLI/test, handlers update user subscription state correctly, email notifications sent on payment failure.

trello.name: Develop Frontend-Backend Integration for Real-time Updates
trello.desc: Connect frontend dashboard and checkout to backend API so subscription changes are reflected immediately in UI. Implement polling or webhook-driven updates to show plan changes, payment status, and errors without manual refresh. Coordinate with Taylor on API contract. Acceptance criteria: after checkout, dashboard updates; after webhook events, UI reflects new status; errors from backend shown clearly to user.

trello.name: Create and Execute Test Plan for Subscription Flow
trello.desc: Prepare detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for full subscription flow: sign-up, payment success/failure, plan upgrade/downgrade, cancellation, webhook handling, invoice access. Include test scenarios for payment failures and cancellations. Share plan with team. Execute tests during 1-week testing phase after initial 2-week integration. Acceptance criteria: test plan documented, all edge cases covered, tests pass for happy path and failure paths.

trello.name: Implement User Notifications and Error Handling
trello.desc: Add user-facing notifications for subscription confirmations, successful upgrades, payment failures, and other Stripe events. Provide clear instructions for fixing failed payments, e.g., update payment method. Handle integration errors gracefully with clear messages. Acceptance criteria: users receive confirmation on successful subscription, clear error messages on payment failure with next steps, notifications appear in dashboard and via email where specified.

trello.name: Create User Documentation and Support FAQ
trello.desc: Plan and draft user documentation and support resources for subscription management. Include help section/FAQ covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, update payment methods, handle issues, and what happens when changing plans. Ensure docs are ready for launch. Acceptance criteria: FAQ covers common subscription questions, documentation is clear and published in help center.

trello.name: Document Backend API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Document all backend API endpoints related to subscriptions and the webhook event handlers for future maintenance and troubleshooting. Include request/response examples, Stripe event mapping, and database updates performed. Acceptance criteria: documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible to team.
